identity.name: Legacy Machine 101
identity.one_liner: The MB&F watch that hangs the balance wheel above the dial on a vertical arch — a 14mm balance with a 2.5Hz oscillation, visible from the front. The most-cited contemporary haute horlogerie design of the 2010s.

provenance_events.description: MB&F's Legacy Machine 101 (LM101) debuts as the brand's most "classical" piece: a suspended balance wheel above a sub-dial, with a 45mm case and an in-house movement. MB&F positions it as a "watchmaker's watch" — the simplest, most personal piece in the Horological Machine catalogue.

narrative.story: The Legacy Machine 101 (LM101) is Max Büsser's tribute to 19th-century pocket-watch chronometer design, updated to a wristwatch format. The signature is the 14mm balance wheel suspended above the dial on a vertical arch — a hand-engraved bridge of polished steel. The result is a watch that looks like a small mechanical planet. The LM101 was followed by the LM101 MB&F × H. Moser in 2020 (a H. Moser × MB&F collaboration), and the LM101 EVO in 2022. The original LM101 ran 2014-2018 in white gold; the 2022 reissue is in steel, titanium, and limited platinum.
